description: Source code for the IndexV1Creator class, which generates a deprecated V1 index from package information using Android PackageManager, and serializes it to JSON.

classes.name: IndexV1Creator
classes.description: A class that creates a deprecated V1 index from package data, serializing it to JSON and managing package info extraction.

methods.name: createRepo
methods.description: Creates the index repository, serializes it to JSON, and returns the IndexV1 object.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Builds the IndexV1 object containing app and package data.

methods.name: addApp
methods.description: Adds app information to the index, handling package info retrieval and logging.

methods.name: getApp
methods.description: Constructs an AppV1 object from PackageInfo.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Constructs a PackageV1 object from PackageInfo, including signature and native code info.
